fixed.member: ShooterAmmoCounter, ShooterCombatHud, ShooterCrosshair, ShooterDamageDirection, ShooterKillfeed, ShooterLoadout
fixed.summary: Shooter components use HTML with CSS while retaining ids, parts and intents. Ammo and reload layers stay in their tracks, optional readouts leave no empty space, and a token-based reticle keyline keeps the aim visible against bright scenes. Loadout columns and the review sheet's non-shrinking footer remain usable at phone width.
